english:
Jan Mayen entered securely documented European history in 1614, when several whaling expeditions reached the isolated volcanic island. Dutch captains Jan Jacobszoon May and Jacob de Gouwenaer were among the visitors; the island's eventual name commemorated May. Willem Blaeu placed that name on his map of Europe in 1620 and mapped the island in greater detail in 1623. Claims of earlier discoveries remain uncertain.

From 1615 to 1638 the Noordsche Compagnie used Jan Mayen as an Arctic whaling base. Seasonal crews established shore stations to render blubber into oil. By the 1620s wooden buildings and brick furnaces replaced makeshift tents and processing sites, and forts were built in 1628. Competition could turn destructive: after a raid on the stations in 1632, seven Dutchmen remained through the winter of 1633–34 to guard the property. All died. The bowhead hunt meanwhile depleted local stocks, and the enterprise was abandoned around 1640. For most of the following two centuries, the island lacked permanent inhabitants, its abandoned stations recording a brief and costly commercial occupation beneath Beerenberg.
simp_chinese:
扬马延岛于1614年进入有确切记录的欧洲航海史，当年数支捕鲸远征抵达这座孤立的火山岛。来访者包括荷兰船长扬·雅各布松·梅和雅各布·德·豪韦纳尔；岛屿后来沿用的名称纪念前者。威廉·布劳在1620年的欧洲地图上标出这一名称，1623年又绘制了更详细的岛图。关于更早发现的说法仍不确定。

1615至1638年，北方公司把这里作为北极捕鲸基地。季节性船员设立岸站，将鲸脂熬成鲸油。到1620年代，木屋和砖炉逐渐取代临时帐篷与简陋加工设施，1628年还修筑堡垒。商业竞争有时演为破坏：1632年岸站遭劫后，七名荷兰人留下度过1633至1634年冬季，以看守财产，最终全部死亡。持续捕猎也使附近弓头鲸数量锐减，经营约于1640年终止。随后近两个世纪的大部分时间，岛上没有常住居民；贝伦火山下废弃的岸站，留下这段短暂而代价高昂的商业占用痕迹。

english:
Janakkala's parish landscape centres on the Church of St Lawrence, the youngest of Tavastia's medieval stone churches. It was probably consecrated on 19 September 1520. Its patron is identified as Åke Tott, the governor of Häme Castle, and three coats of arms of the Tott family remain on the eastern gable. The stone church connected a rural parish with one of the region's powerful noble households.

The original building was a rectangular, single-nave church with a sacristy and porch projecting from its longer sides. Local tradition places an earlier wooden church nearby; graves discovered during road works have been associated with that predecessor. The parish subsequently added a substantial bell tower between 1784 and 1792 under the master builder Martti Tolpo. Its stone lower storey formed an entrance to the churchyard, while the upper part also served as a parish granary. Worship, burial and the storage of grain thus came together in the same church precinct, whose buildings served practical as well as religious functions.
simp_chinese:
亚纳卡拉教区景观以圣劳伦斯教堂为中心，这是塔瓦斯特兰中世纪石教堂中建造最晚的一座，可能于1520年9月19日祝圣启用。主持兴建者被认为是海梅城堡长官奥克·托特，东山墙至今保留托特家族三枚纹章，将乡村教区与地区贵族家族相连。

原教堂为长方形单中殿建筑，长边附设祭衣室及门廊。地方传统认为附近曾有较早的木教堂，修路发现的墓葬也被认为与前身建筑有关。1784至1792年，教区又由营造师马尔蒂·托尔波主持修建钟楼。钟楼底层为石砌，形成进入墓地的通道，上部还曾用作教区粮仓。礼拜、埋葬与粮食储藏因而汇聚在同一教堂区域，建筑兼具宗教和实际生活功能。

english: Janakpur lies in the forested hill country of Chang Bhakar, northwest of the Chota Nagpur plateau. It was a seat of the small Chang Bhakar estate, whose ruling family belonged to a branch of the Chauhans of Korea. The surrounding country is marked by hills and forests rather than the open plains farther east. In the early nineteenth century the rulers established their seat at Bharatpur.
simp_chinese: 贾纳克布尔位于昌巴卡尔林木茂密的丘陵地区，在乔塔那格浦尔高原西北方。这里曾是昌巴卡尔小邦的治所，其统治家族属于科里亚乔汉家族的一个分支。周围以山丘与森林为主，与更东面的开阔平原不同。十九世纪初，统治者将治所设在巴拉特布尔。

english:
Janakpur's sacred geography identifies the Mithila plain with Janaka's kingdom and with Sita, whose marriage to Rama anchors the town's pilgrimage tradition. Its early modern growth depended on religious specialists and landed support. Traditions associate Chaturbhuj Giri with the establishment of the Ram temple and Surkishor with the Janaki shrine, linking ascetic activity to the renewed prominence of the sacred site.

The Ram temple's endowments crossed changes of dynasty. A later royal confirmation records grants attributed to Makwanpur's Sen rulers in 1657 and 1751, followed by Prithvi Narayan Shah in 1769 and Pratap Singh Shah in 1774. These grants supplied a material foundation for worship and the succession of temple heads. Amar Singh Thapa commissioned the pagoda-style Ram Mandir in 1782 beside Dhanush Sagar. Long before the later monumental Janaki temple, this shrine and its endowed lands gave Janakpur a lasting institutional centre for Rama devotion.
simp_chinese:
贾纳克布尔的神圣地理，将弥梯罗平原与遮那竭王国、悉多联系起来；悉多与罗摩的婚姻故事，构成当地朝圣传统的核心。近代早期的宗教复兴依靠修行者与土地捐赠。传统将罗摩庙的创立归于恰图尔布杰·吉里，将札纳基神庙与苏尔基绍尔相联系，反映了苦行者活动与圣地声名恢复之间的关系。

罗摩庙的捐田延续于王朝更替之中。后来王室颁发的确认文书，追述了马克万普尔森王朝统治者在1657年、1751年的赐地，以及普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿1769年、普拉塔普·辛格·沙阿1774年的捐赠。这些土地为祭祀与历任住持提供物质基础。1782年，阿马尔·辛格·塔帕在达努什萨迦池旁主持修建塔式罗摩庙。早在后来宏伟的札纳基庙出现之前，这座神庙及其田产便已成为罗摩信仰的持久机构中心。

english: Janaúba lies in the valley of the Gorutuba River in northern Minas Gerais. Its name refers to a milky plant also known as silk cotton. Along the river lived the Gorutubanos, a community with Indigenous and African ancestry, including people who had escaped enslavement. Their settlements in the fertile valley date back to the late eighteenth century, long before the town of Janaúba itself grew up beside the river.
simp_chinese: 雅瑙巴位于米纳斯吉拉斯北部的戈鲁图巴河谷。地名指一种含乳汁的植物，又称丝棉。戈鲁图巴诺人沿河居住，这一社群有原住民和非洲血缘，其中包括逃离奴役的人们。他们在肥沃河谷中的聚落可追溯至十八世纪末，早于雅瑙巴城镇本身在河边兴起。

english:
Jand stood on the lower Syr Darya, a town whose reputation once reached far enough for geographers to call the Aral Sea the Sea of Jand. Muslim merchants encountered the products of the steppe and forest country here, and the town figured prominently in traditions about the origins of the Seljuks. Its importance rested on connections between settled river communities and the Oghuz world beyond them.

The Mongol conquest brought Jand into Jochi's sphere during the campaigns against Khwarazm. Yet the town did not simply continue unchanged through the later Middle Ages. An early fourteenth-century Chinese map still named it Jan-di; by the end of that century it apparently ceased to exist. Jand's place in the lower river landscape therefore belongs partly to the memory of an earlier urban centre. Its medieval prominence survived in geographical writing even as the inhabited town declined.
simp_chinese:
毡的位于锡尔河下游，昔日声望甚广，地理著作甚至曾将咸海称为“毡的海”。穆斯林商人在这里接触草原与森林地区的物产，这座城也在塞尔柱起源传统中占有重要位置。它的意义建立在沿河定居社群与周围乌古斯世界的联系之上。

蒙古征服花剌子模期间，毡的进入术赤的势力范围。不过，这座城在中世纪后期并未始终维持原有规模。十四世纪初的中国地图仍将其标作“Jan-di”，到该世纪末，它似乎已不再存在。因此，毡的在锡尔河下游景观中的地位，也包含一座较早城市留下的历史记忆。即使聚落衰落，其中世纪声名仍存于地理记述之中。

english:
Jang Tana, or Tana Monastery, stood in Nangchen in eastern Tibet as a centre of the Yelpa Kagyu tradition. Yelpa Yeshe Tsek took possession of the monastery in 1188, under the patronage associated with the chief of Ling. This older foundation linked the institution with a religious lineage and an aristocratic network that remained important in the later medieval history of Kham.

Tana became particularly associated with relics attributed to Gesar of Ling, including scriptures, weapons and armour. The account of their donation belongs to the monastery's historical tradition; the exact date is uncertain, and scholarship allows that it may have occurred later than the founder's lifetime, perhaps in the fourteenth or fifteenth century. These objects connected Buddhist patronage with the prestige of a regional epic hero. In the wider Nangchen and Kham world, Gesar's oral traditions and Buddhist ritual developed together, especially from the seventeenth century. Tana's setting therefore combines monastic transmission with the preservation and religious interpretation of a shared regional memory.
simp_chinese:
江塔纳即达那寺，位于藏东囊谦，是叶巴噶举传承的中心。叶巴·益西则于1188年接掌寺院，其支持者同岭地首领有关。这一较早基础，使寺院联系一条宗教传承，以及在康区中世纪后期仍然重要的贵族网络。

达那寺尤其以保存被认为属于岭格萨尔的遗物闻名，包括经典、武器与甲胄。捐献故事属于寺院历史传统，确切日期未定；研究认为，也可能发生在创始人去世以后，例如十四或十五世纪。这些物品将佛教施主关系，同区域史诗英雄的声望相连。在更广大的囊谦与康区世界，格萨尔口头传统与佛教仪式共同发展，十七世纪以后尤为明显。达那寺的环境因此结合着僧院传承，以及对共有区域记忆的保存和宗教阐释。

sources.title: An Early Tibetan Gesar bsang Text.pdf

english: Jangheung lay in southern Jeolla, where coastal defence repeatedly shaped local government. Japanese raiding in the late Goryeo period drove residents away and prompted the construction of mountain fortifications. In 1392 an official established the administrative seat in a fortress on Jungnyeong Mountain. Jangheung became a dohobu, a civil and military prefecture, in 1413; the following year the seat moved again because the mountain enclosure was too cramped. The Japanese raid of 1555 killed magistrate Han On and inflicted heavy losses on the population. During the invasions beginning in 1592, local men served with Yi Sun-sin or joined volunteer forces fighting inland. Military headquarters moved from Gangjin to Jangheung in 1599, then returned in 1604. A later command established in 1666 was likewise transferred to Suncheon in 1683. Beyond these military changes, the district supported a scholarly tradition represented by the poet and calligrapher Baek Gwang-hun and the eighteenth-century practical-learning scholar Wi Baek-gyu.
simp_chinese: 长兴位于全罗南部，沿海防务屡次改变地方行政。高丽末期，倭寇侵袭迫使居民迁离，也促成了多处山城的修筑。1392年，地方官在中宁山筑城，将官署设在城内。1413年，长兴成为都护府；次年又因山城狭窄而迁治。1555年的倭寇袭击造成府使韩蕴战死，居民也遭受重大损失。1592年开始的战争中，当地人有的随李舜臣作战，有的加入义兵，在内陆抗敌。1599年，兵营由康津移至长兴，1604年又迁回原处；1666年另设的军镇也在1683年转移到顺天。地方历史并不只有防御与迁治。诗人、书法家白光勋，以及十八世纪实学学者魏伯珪，代表了这里延续发展的文人传统。军事职责与地方学术生活共同构成长兴在朝鲜王朝时期的面貌。

english: Jangipur stands on the Bhagirathi in the river country of Bengal. Its name is understood as a shortened form of Jahangirpur, and local tradition attributes its foundation to the Mughal emperor Jahangir. The river connects the town with the wider waterways of Murshidabad, where settlements grew along channels carrying people and goods through the fertile plains. An imperial camp is also associated with Jangipur in accounts of the Mughal period.
simp_chinese: 詹吉布尔位于孟加拉河网地区的巴吉拉蒂河畔。它的名称被认为是贾汉吉尔布尔的缩写，当地传说将城镇的建立归于莫卧儿皇帝贾汉吉尔。这条河使城镇与穆尔希达巴德更广阔的水道相连，沿河聚落依靠水路，在肥沃平原间运送人员和货物。有关莫卧儿时期的记述还将此地与一处帝国军营联系起来。

english: Jangjin lay deep in the mountains of northern Korea, where distance from Hamheung complicated civil government. A memorial submitted in the seventh lunar month of 1787 described nearly three thousand households spread across more than four hundred li; over half had migrated from elsewhere. A military commander was already handling civil affairs, but without the clerks and legal machinery of a regular magistracy. Murder investigations exposed the difficulty: bringing the Hamheung official to examine a body involved a journey of five or six days, and summer decay could undermine the evidence. The proposal to establish a civil district also stressed the mountain routes leading northwest and the need to control them. Officials worried that new taxes and compulsory labour might drive settlers away. Advocates therefore urged light demands and a capable magistrate, using existing military buildings and local timber for the necessary offices. King Jeongjo approved the proposal and ordered detailed arrangements, bringing frontier administration into closer reach of these scattered households.
simp_chinese: 长津深处朝鲜北部山地，远离咸兴，民政与司法都受交通限制。1787年农历七月的一份奏疏记载，此地幅员四百余里，居民接近三千户，其中过半来自外地。当地军官已经兼管民事，却缺少正式地方官署应有的吏员与司法机构。命案尤其暴露这一困难：请咸兴官员前来验尸，往返需五六日，夏季尸体腐坏又可能妨碍查明案情。奏疏还强调西北方向的山间通道，认为设立民政辖区有助于控制这些路线。反对者担忧，增设官署将带来赋税和徭役，使移民再次逃散。因此，主张设邑者建议选任能吏、减轻征派，并利用现有军署与当地木材建造必要设施。正祖批准了设邑建议，命令进一步筹划具体制度，使分散山户不必事事依赖遥远的咸兴。

english: Changyŏn occupies the western end of Hwanghae, where a broken coastline opens into the Yellow Sea. Its shores include landing places such as Monggŭmp'o and Pisŏkp'o, sheltered among the headlands and islands. From 1768 the local magistrate also served as a naval commander, directing the maritime forces of five coastal counties and districts. The post reflected the importance of guarding the province's seaward approaches.
simp_chinese: 长渊位于黄海道西端，曲折海岸面向黄海。海岬和岛屿之间有梦金浦、碑石浦等船只停靠之处。自1768年起，地方官兼任水军营将，指挥沿海五个郡县的水军。这一职务显示出守卫本道海上门户的重要性。

english:
Janjira's island fort rose from the sea off Danda-Rajpuri on the Konkan coast. Its Siddi commanders, of African ancestry, built their power through naval service to the Deccan sultanates and later the Mughals. The island and its mainland possessions gave them an armed foothold among coastal communities, while their ships could escort commerce or raid an enemy's shore.

Shivaji's expansion brought repeated attacks against the Siddis in the seventeenth century. The Marathas gained mainland forts and threatened their supply bases, but neither Shivaji nor Sambhaji secured Janjira itself. Its survival depended on sea access as well as stone walls. Rivalries within the ruling house invited further Maratha intervention in 1733, and fighting continued over the adjoining territory. In 1759 Janjira's government obtained Jafarabad on the Kathiawar coast with English assistance; the relationship also helped provision Bombay with cattle. English intervention again protected the island against Maratha pressure around 1761. By 1818 the Siddi ruler acknowledged British authority, retaining a small coastal state whose fortunes had long depended on alliances across the western Indian Ocean.
simp_chinese:
金吉拉海岛堡垒矗立于康坎海岸丹达—拉杰普里外海。具有非洲血统的西迪将领先后为德干苏丹国与莫卧儿帝国效力，凭借海军建立势力。岛堡及其大陆领地使他们立足于沿岸社群之间，船队既能护航，也能袭击敌方海岸。

十七世纪湿婆吉扩张，屡次进攻西迪人。马拉塔夺取大陆城堡，威胁其补给据点，但湿婆吉和桑巴吉均未夺下金吉拉本岛。海上补给与坚固城墙同样支撑着要塞。1733年统治家族的内争又招来马拉塔干预，毗邻领土此后仍反复争夺。1759年，金吉拉在英国人协助下取得卡提阿瓦海岸的贾法拉巴德，双方关系也有助于为孟买供应牲畜；约1761年，英国干预再次使岛堡免遭马拉塔夺占。1818年，西迪统治者承认英国权威，保留这一小型沿海邦国。它的命运始终与印度洋西部的海上联盟密切相连。

english:
Jannaba, also known as Ganava, is a port on the Persian Gulf coast. Medieval geographers described it as a trading centre of Fars: in the tenth century its people gathered pearls, built ships and produced brocade for export. By the thirteenth century, the traveller Qazvini described a small coastal town with brackish water and poor soil.

The neighbouring gulf coast remained a place of commerce and rivalry. In 1766 Mir Muhanna of Bandar Rig took the Dutch East India Company's fort on Kharg Island, off this shore. The episode illustrates the changing balance of power among local rulers, Iranian authorities and European traders in the waters around Ganava.
simp_chinese:
詹纳巴又称加纳韦，是波斯湾沿岸的港口。中世纪地理学家将它描述为法尔斯的商业中心：10世纪，当地采集珍珠、建造船只，并生产锦缎外销。到了13世纪，旅行家卡兹维尼笔下的它已是一座水质苦咸、土地贫瘠的海滨小镇。

附近的海湾沿岸仍是商业与势力竞争之地。1766年，班达尔里格的米尔·穆汉纳攻占了近海哈尔克岛上的荷兰东印度公司堡垒。这一事件反映出加纳韦周围海域中地方统治者、伊朗政权与欧洲商人之间不断变化的力量关系。

english: Jannah is an island off the eastern Arabian coast, near Ras al-Khair in the Persian Gulf. Low-lying land and shallow waters mark this stretch of shore, where islands stand between the mainland and the open gulf. The coast belongs to the region historically known as Bahrain, a name once applied to a broad part of eastern Arabia as well as to the islands farther south.
simp_chinese: 詹纳岛位于阿拉伯东岸外的波斯湾，靠近海尔角。这段海岸地势低平，海水浅，岛屿分布在大陆与开阔海湾之间。这里属于历史上称为巴林的地区；这一名称曾涵盖东阿拉伯大片土地，也包括更南方的岛屿。

english: Jannat Shahr lies in the Darab country of southern Fars, near the foothills of the Zagros. In the neighbouring Hajjiabad plain, a richly decorated mud-brick building and water system date to the reign of the Sasanian king Shapur II. The building appears to have been connected with a settlement known as Jannat Shahr, evidence of an old inhabited landscape in the Darab plain.
simp_chinese: 詹纳特沙赫尔位于法尔斯南部的达拉卜地区，靠近扎格罗斯山麓。邻近的哈吉阿巴德平原上，一座装饰精美的土砖建筑及供水系统可追溯至萨珊国王沙普尔二世时期。建筑似乎与一处称为詹纳特沙赫尔的聚落有关，见证达拉卜平原古老的居住历史。

english: Janów lies on the Białka at the edge of the forests south of Lublin. The noblewoman Katarzyna Zamoyska founded the town on the road between Zamość and Sandomierz, receiving a royal privilege in 1640. Originally called Biała, it was renamed Janów for her son Jan Zamoyski. Cossacks burned the young town in 1648, and disease followed. Seeking to rebuild it, Jan permitted Jewish settlers to establish themselves in 1652; Polish-allied Tatars also settled here, and Dominicans arrived in 1660.
simp_chinese: 亚努夫位于卢布林以南森林边缘的比亚瓦卡河畔。贵族妇人卡塔日娜·扎莫伊斯卡在扎莫希奇至桑多梅日的道路上创建城镇，1640年获得王室特许。新城起初称为比亚瓦，后来以她的儿子扬·扎莫伊斯基命名为亚努夫。1648年，哥萨克焚毁这座年轻的城镇，随后瘟疫接踵而至。为重建家园，扬于1652年允许犹太人定居；与波兰结盟的鞑靼人也在此落户，多明我会士则于1660年到来。

english:
Jansath was a home base of the Barha Sayyids in the upper Doab. Two members of this military aristocracy, Abdullah Khan and Husain Ali Khan, became decisive figures in Mughal politics after Aurangzeb's death. They helped Farrukhsiyar obtain the throne in 1713 and then held the empire's leading civil and military offices. Their authority rested partly on the soldiers and family connections of their home region.

Jansath's links to the court were broader than the two brothers. Ratan Chand, a Hindu merchant from the town, became Abdullah's trusted official for financial and clerical work. In 1719 the brothers deposed Farrukhsiyar and supported a succession of replacement emperors. Their dominance ended in 1720, when Husain Ali was killed and Abdullah defeated and imprisoned. Members of their following withdrew their families to Jansath. The town's early eighteenth-century history therefore reached into the struggle over the Mughal succession while remaining a place of family refuge and local connections.
simp_chinese:
詹萨特是上河间地巴尔哈赛义德家族的一处根基地。军事贵族中的阿卜杜拉汗与侯赛因·阿里汗两兄弟，在奥朗则布去世后成为莫卧儿政治中的关键人物。他们帮助法鲁克锡亚于1713年登位，随后掌握帝国最重要的文武职务，权势部分依靠故乡地区的兵员与家族联系。

詹萨特与朝廷的联系也超出两兄弟本人。来自镇上的印度教商人拉坦·昌德，成为阿卜杜拉信任的财政与文书官员。1719年，两兄弟废黜法鲁克锡亚，接连拥立皇帝。1720年，侯赛因·阿里被杀，阿卜杜拉战败入狱，兄弟的主导地位结束。其追随者将家属撤往詹萨特。城镇由此卷入莫卧儿皇位之争，同时仍是家族避难与地方关系的依托。

english:
Japallan is identifiable with Japallan, also written Rapallan or Sapallan, a fortified-looking archaeological settlement above the Tantamayo River in the upper Maranon country of Huanuco. Its steep mountain position separates it from the better-known towns of the Conchucos valleys across the Maranon. Walls, circular towers, residential rooms and funerary structures survive among its stone-and-earth buildings. Some upper buildings rise through several levels, while lower parts of the complex contain numerous doorways and rooms.

The settlement belongs to the pre-Inca heritage of the Tantamayo region. Its architecture provides more direct evidence of local society than a securely dated list of rulers or conquests. The commanding position has encouraged an interpretation as a lookout or defensive centre, but it does not by itself prove a particular battle or military function for every building. The wider highland setting later entered the Inca and Spanish worlds; the surviving ruins should not therefore be treated as proof of continuous occupation throughout 1337–1837. Japallan's distinctive historical character lies in the concentration of substantial stone buildings on a precipitous summit above the river valleys.
simp_chinese:
哈帕扬可对应瓦努科上马拉尼翁地区、坦塔马约河上方的同名遗址，也有Rapallán或Sapallán的拼写。聚落位于陡峭山顶，同马拉尼翁河对岸较为知名的孔丘科河谷城镇有地理区别。石土建筑中保存围墙、圆形塔楼、居室与墓葬结构。上部一些建筑具有多层空间，下部则可见众多门道和房间。

这处聚落属于坦塔马约地区前印加时代的遗产。相较于缺乏可靠年代的统治者或征服年表，建筑本身为地方社会提供了更直接的证据。居高临下的位置使其被解释为瞭望或防御中心，但仅凭地形，无法证明这里发生过某场战役，也无法把每栋建筑都认定为军事设施。更广阔的高地后来进入印加及西班牙统治范围；现存遗迹并不证明1337至1837年间始终有人连续居住。哈帕扬独特的历史面貌，来自河谷上方险峻山顶上密集而坚实的石建筑群。

english: The Philippine Sea stretches south of Honshu and east of the Izu Islands. The warm Kuroshio current flows northeastward past the Japanese islands, carrying water from lower latitudes into the Pacific. Volcanic islands rise from the sea along the Izu chain, providing landmarks in a broad expanse of water. Winds, currents and seasonal storms shaped the passage of vessels between the islands and the coast of Honshu.
simp_chinese: 菲律宾海位于本州以南、伊豆群岛以东。温暖的黑潮沿日本列岛向东北流动，将低纬度海水带入太平洋。伊豆列岛的火山岛屿从海面升起，为广阔水域提供地标。风、洋流和季节性风暴影响船只在诸岛与本州海岸之间的航程。

english: South of the Sakishima Islands, the Philippine Sea stretches between the southern Ryūkyūs and the open Pacific. The islands lie in warm subtropical waters, with coral reefs around many shores. The Kuroshio current carries warm water northward past Taiwan and the Ryūkyū chain. Winds and typhoons also shape the sea, making voyages between these scattered islands and neighbouring coasts dependent on the season.
simp_chinese: 先岛群岛以南的菲律宾海位于琉球南部与开阔太平洋之间。岛屿处在温暖的亚热带水域，许多海岸周围环绕珊瑚礁。黑潮从台湾和琉球岛链附近向北输送暖水。风和台风也塑造海况，使散布诸岛与邻近海岸之间的航行受季节影响。

english:
The Philippine Sea off the Sakishima Islands faces the southern end of the Ryukyu chain, where Miyako and Yaeyama form the inhabited shores nearest the open water. These seas belonged to a larger maritime world connecting Ryukyu with China, Japan and Southeast Asia. From the fourteenth through sixteenth centuries, Ryukyuan merchants acted as intermediaries, carrying Chinese silks and pottery, Japanese goods and southern products through networks sustained by tributary relations and seafaring.

The political framework changed after Satsuma invaded the Ryukyu Kingdom in 1609. The kingdom continued diplomatic and commercial relations with China while coming under Japanese influence, giving the island chain overlapping connections to both powers. The open sea also carried dangers that reached far beyond an individual voyage. On 24 April 1771 a great tsunami struck Yaeyama and Miyako from the sea south-southeast of Ishigaki. Thousands died, and waves carried massive coral blocks inland. For the communities around these waters, the sea was therefore a route for contact and obligation, a source of food and an unpredictable force capable of transforming the shores on which their settlements depended.
simp_chinese:
先岛诸岛外侧的菲律宾海面向琉球岛链南端，宫古与八重山构成邻近远海的有人岛岸。这片海域属于连接琉球、中国、日本与东南亚的海洋世界。十四至十六世纪，琉球商人充当中介，在朝贡关系和航海活动支持的网络中转运中国丝绸、陶瓷、日本商品与南方物产。

1609年萨摩入侵琉球王国后，政治框架发生变化。王国在接受日本影响的同时，继续与中国维持外交和商业关系，岛链由此同时连接两方。外海也带来超越单次航行的危险。1771年4月24日，大海啸从石垣岛南南东方向袭击八重山和宫古，造成数千人死亡，巨浪甚至将庞大珊瑚岩块带入陆地。对于围绕这片水域生活的社群，海洋既是往来与履行义务的通道，也是食物来源；其难以预测的力量，又能够改变聚落赖以生存的岸线。

english: North of Luzon, the waters of the Philippine Sea reach towards the Babuyan Islands and the passages leading to Taiwan. The islands stand off Cagayan's northern coast, beyond the broad valley enclosed by the Cordillera and Sierra Madre mountains. Open water separates them from the larger island to the south and the islands of Batanes farther north.
simp_chinese: 吕宋岛以北，菲律宾海延伸至巴布延群岛和通往台湾的水道。群岛位于卡加延北岸之外，科迪勒拉山脉与马德雷山脉环抱的广阔河谷也在其南方。开阔水域将这些岛屿与南面的吕宋岛、北面的巴丹群岛分开。

english: Off the Pacific coast of central Honshu, these waters lie south of the Tōkaidō shore. The warm Kuroshio flows northeastward along Japan, influencing the sea’s temperature and the course of ships. The coast to the north is indented by bays and marked by peninsulas, while the open Philippine Sea extends to the south. Seasonal winds and storms make conditions change across this passage between coastal havens.
simp_chinese: 本州中部太平洋海岸外的这片水域位于东海道南方。温暖的黑潮沿日本向东北流动，影响海水温度和船只航程。北方海岸有深入陆地的海湾和伸向海面的半岛，南方则是开阔的菲律宾海。季节风和风暴使连接沿岸避风港的航路条件不断变化。

english: South of the Japanese mainland, the Philippine Sea opens beyond the coasts of Shikoku and Kii. The warm Kuroshio current flows northeastward through these waters, bringing warmth from the south along the Pacific side of Japan. Ships following the coast encountered its currents and seasonal storms before reaching the sheltered bays and headlands of the islands. Farther offshore, the sea extends into the open Pacific.
simp_chinese: 日本本土以南的菲律宾海延伸在四国与纪伊海岸之外。温暖的黑潮在这片水域向东北流动，将南方暖水带到日本太平洋一侧。沿岸航行的船只在驶近岛屿避风海湾和岬角时，必须应对洋流与季节风暴；更远的外海则通向开阔的太平洋。

english: The waters south of Shikoku belong to the Philippine Sea, beyond the island’s Pacific coast. The Kuroshio flows northeastward past southern Japan, bringing warm water towards the shores of Shikoku and Honshu. Coastal headlands and bays lie to the north, while open ocean stretches southward. For sailors, the current and the seasonal storms of the Pacific were important features of the passage along this coast.
simp_chinese: 四国以南的水域属于菲律宾海，位于岛屿太平洋海岸之外。黑潮流经日本南部并向东北前进，将暖水带向四国和本州海岸。北方是岬角与海湾，南方则是开阔海洋。对水手而言，洋流和太平洋上的季节风暴是沿岸航行必须考虑的重要条件。

english: The Philippine Sea extends east of the Ōsumi Islands, south of Kyushu. The Kuroshio passes through the waters around the island chain before turning northeast towards the Pacific coast of Japan. Volcanic islands rise above the current, marking the route between Kyushu and the Ryūkyū archipelago. Ships travelling here encountered warm waters, strong currents and seasonal storms as they moved between island anchorages.
simp_chinese: 菲律宾海位于九州以南的大隅群岛以东。黑潮流经岛链周围水域，再向东北转往日本太平洋海岸。火山岛从洋流中升起，标示着九州与琉球群岛之间的航路。船只往来各岛锚地时，须应对温暖海水、强劲洋流和季节性风暴。

english: East of the Ryūkyū island chain, the Philippine Sea opens toward the Pacific. Warm water carried north by the Kuroshio passes through the seas around the islands, whose scattered shores offer landfalls between Kyushu and Okinawa. Strong currents and seasonal typhoons could make crossings difficult for small sailing vessels. The islands provide points of shelter in an otherwise broad and exposed stretch of water.
simp_chinese: 琉球岛链以东的菲律宾海向太平洋展开。黑潮将暖水带向北方，流经诸岛周围；散布的海岸为九州与冲绳之间的航行提供登陆地点。强劲洋流和季节性台风可能使小型帆船渡海艰难，岛屿则在广阔、暴露于风浪的水域中提供避风处。

english: The sea east of the Ryūkyū Islands forms part of the Philippine Sea, a wide Pacific basin bordered by chains of islands. Okinawa and the islands to its north lie to the west of these waters. The warm Kuroshio flows north through the region, while typhoons bring powerful winds and seas in season. Travel between the scattered islands depended on careful attention to weather and currents.
simp_chinese: 琉球群岛以东的海域属于菲律宾海，这片宽广的太平洋海盆边缘分布着岛链。冲绳及其北方诸岛位于这片水域以西。温暖的黑潮向北流经这一地区，季节性的台风则带来强风和巨浪。船只往来分散的岛屿时，必须仔细留意天气和洋流。

english: The waters east of Okinawa open into the Philippine Sea, beyond the sheltered shores of the Ryūkyū Islands. The island chain separates this Pacific basin from the East China Sea, and the warm Kuroshio current flows north through the region. Small vessels travelling between the islands had to reckon with the current and with seasonal typhoons, seeking the protection of bays and reefs when weather turned severe.
simp_chinese: 冲绳以东的水域越过琉球群岛避风海岸，通向菲律宾海。岛链将这片太平洋海盆与东海分隔开来，温暖的黑潮向北流经这一地区。往来诸岛的小船须应对洋流和季节性台风，天气恶劣时便在海湾与礁石之间寻找庇护。

english:
The waters beside Okinawa formed part of the maritime world of the Ryukyu Islands. Chuzan's King Satto sent an embassy to Ming China in 1372, beginning a relationship sustained by voyages carrying tribute, envoys and traded goods. Sho Hashi united the island's three kingdoms in 1429. From its political centre at Shuri, the resulting kingdom developed commercial and diplomatic contacts with China, Japan, Korea and Southeast Asia.

These connections made nearby seas essential to the royal court's dealings with larger powers. Maritime exchange also contributed to the distinctive culture expressed in Ryukyu's castles and sacred places. In 1609 Satsuma invaded the kingdom and occupied Shuri Castle. Thereafter the Ryukyuan monarchy continued to maintain its relationship with China while operating under Satsuma and Tokugawa authority. Seaborne diplomacy thus persisted through a major change in political circumstances. Around Okinawa, voyages belonged to overlapping tributary and subordinate relationships, linking the island court to a wider network that could not be represented by a single straightforward frontier.
simp_chinese:
冲绳附近海域属于琉球群岛的航海世界。1372年，中山王察度遣使前往明朝，开启由贡品、使节与贸易货物航行维系的关系。1429年，尚巴志统一岛上三山，形成以首里为政治中心的王国，逐渐同中国、日本、朝鲜及东南亚发展商业和外交往来。

海上联系使周围水域成为王室与较大政治力量交涉的基础，也参与塑造琉球城堡与圣地表现出的独特文化。1609年，萨摩入侵并占领首里城。此后琉球王室继续维持中国关系，同时受到萨摩和德川幕府权力制约，海上外交在重大政治变化中延续。冲绳周围的航行由此处在相互重叠的朝贡与从属关系之中，将岛屿王廷接入无法用一道简单边界概括的广阔网络。

english: Jaqi Jiwata rises to roughly 4,620 metres in the Bolivian Andes. Its Aymara name means “dead man”, and the mountain stands between Iru Pata to the southwest and Qala Piwrani to the northeast. High ridges and steep valleys shape this part of the Andean uplands, where the cold, thin air and exposed slopes contrast with the lower country descending toward the east.
simp_chinese: 哈基希瓦塔山耸立在玻利维亚安第斯山脉，海拔约4620米。其艾马拉语名称意为“死者”，山峰位于西南方的伊鲁帕塔和东北方的卡拉皮乌拉尼之间。高峻山脊与陡峭谷地塑造这片安第斯高地，寒冷稀薄的空气和裸露坡面，与向东下降的较低地带形成鲜明对比。

english: Jarabacoa lies in a mountain valley of Hispaniola’s Cordillera Central. The Yaque del Norte, Jimenoa and Baiguate rivers cross the surrounding high country, descending through wooded slopes and steep valleys. Its name is of Taíno origin, recalling Indigenous communities who knew this well-watered region before Spanish conquest. In the early nineteenth century people from the lowlands took refuge in the mountains, and settlement in the valley grew.
simp_chinese: 哈拉瓦科阿坐落在伊斯帕尼奥拉中央山脉的山谷中。北雅克河、希梅诺阿河与拜瓜特河穿过周围高地，沿森林山坡与陡峭河谷流下。地名源自泰诺语，使人想起西班牙征服之前熟悉这片多水地区的原住民社群。十九世纪初，一些低地居民到山中避难，河谷聚落随之增长。

english:
Jaragua was a Taíno chiefdom in the southwestern country of Hispaniola, governed by Bohechío and later by his sister Anacaona. Its political relationships joined the leading ruler to subordinate chiefs and their communities. Spanish demands for tribute entered that structure during the first years of colonisation, when the conquerors sought supplies as well as gold.

In 1496 Bohechío accepted an arrangement under which tribute could be delivered in products such as cotton, maize and cassava bread. Bartolomé Columbus returned by sea the following year to collect it and was received with ceremonies and gifts. These exchanges combined accommodation with an unequal demand backed by colonial power. Early in the sixteenth century, Governor Nicolás de Ovando turned against Jaragua's leadership. Chiefs gathered for a reception were killed, and Anacaona was captured and executed. The violence broke the political accommodation through which Jaragua's rulers had tried to manage relations with the newcomers.

The later city of Port-au-Prince lies here.
simp_chinese:
哈拉瓜是伊斯帕尼奥拉西南地域的泰诺酋邦，先由博埃奇奥统治，后由其妹阿纳卡奥娜继掌权力。首领与下属酋长、社群构成政治联系；殖民初期，西班牙人索取黄金以外的供应品，也将贡赋要求加到这一体系上。

1496年，博埃奇奥接受以棉花、玉米、木薯饼等物缴贡的安排。次年，巴托洛梅·哥伦布乘船回来收取，受到仪式与赠礼接待。这些往来兼有协商，也包含殖民武力支持的不平等索取。十六世纪初，总督尼古拉斯·德奥万多转而打击哈拉瓜领导层：聚集迎接他的酋长遭杀害，阿纳卡奥娜被俘后处决。暴力摧毁了当地统治者试图借以处理同外来者关系的政治妥协。

后来的太子港即位于此地。

english:
Jaraicejo stood beside a crossing of the Almonte that mattered to the movement of people and livestock through Extremadura. The bridge now called the Puente del Cardenal was built in stages. Its first section dates to the fifteenth century and the patronage of Bishop Juan de Carvajal of Plasencia.

In 1493 the Catholic Monarchs ordered repairs. The Mesta offered 20,000 maravedíes towards the work, with the remaining cost to be shared among neighbouring councils and landholders who used the crossing. This participation reflected the bridge's importance to migrating sheep along the Cañada Real Leonesa Occidental. A seventeenth-century addition supplied six further arches, giving the bridge its extended form. Its construction and repairs joined episcopal patronage, royal orders and the practical needs of pastoral traffic.
simp_chinese:
哈赖塞霍邻近阿尔蒙特河渡口，是埃斯特雷马杜拉人员与牲畜往来途中的重要地点。如今称为枢机桥的石桥分期建成，最早的一段始于15世纪，由普拉森西亚主教胡安·德·卡瓦哈尔赞助。

1493年，天主教双王下令修桥。梅斯塔牧业组织出资两万马拉维迪，其余费用由使用渡口的邻近市镇和地主分摊。这一安排体现了桥梁对沿莱昂西部王家牧道迁徙的羊群的重要性。17世纪的增建又添六孔桥拱，使桥体得到延伸。建造与维修，把主教赞助、王室命令和牧业交通的实际需求联系起来。

english: Jaranwala lies in the Rechna Doab, the tract between the Ravi and Chenab rivers in the Punjab. Before the expansion of the town, the name was associated with a Kharral settlement in the Bar, the relatively dry country between the great rivers. Its plains contrast with the river valleys on either side, where channels and floodwaters have long shaped cultivation and settlement.
simp_chinese: 贾兰瓦拉位于旁遮普的雷奇纳两河间地，即拉维河与杰纳布河之间的土地。城镇扩展之前，这个名字与巴尔地区的一处卡拉尔人聚落有关；巴尔是大河之间较为干燥的地带。这里的平原与两侧河谷形成对照，河道和洪水长期塑造着河谷中的耕作与定居。

english: Jarawa was a town of the eastern Maghreb associated with the Idrisid prince Abu al-Aysh Isa. Medieval accounts describe a walled settlement with a citadel, a congregational mosque, bathhouses and wells, surrounded by cultivated land and villages. In the tenth century control of the town became entangled in the struggles of the region's rulers, and Abu al-Aysh's son al-Hasan was driven out by Musa ibn Abi al-Afiya.
simp_chinese: 贾拉瓦是马格里布东部的一座城镇，与伊德里斯王朝王子阿布·艾什·伊萨有关。中世纪记载称，城镇筑有城墙和堡垒，内有聚礼清真寺、浴室和水井，周围是耕地与村落。十世纪，争夺这座城的斗争卷入地方统治者之间的战争，阿布·艾什之子哈桑被穆萨·伊本·阿比·阿菲亚逐出。

english: The Jardines de la Reina formed a chain of small islands and shallow passages off Cuba's southern coast. During his second American voyage in 1494, Christopher Columbus approached from Jamaica and Cape Cruz, then tried to follow the coast westward through these waters. Narrow channels and numerous keys made navigation difficult. He gave the island group the name Garden of the Queen, commemorating the Spanish monarchy within the geography recorded by the expedition. The episode illustrates a practical constraint that a map of the open Caribbean can obscure: vessels nearing Cuba's southern shore had to negotiate a maze of shoals and island passages. The group belonged to an inhabited Caribbean world before this European naming, but the voyage account alone does not establish the locations or histories of individual Indigenous settlements among its keys.
simp_chinese: 女王花园群岛由古巴南岸外一系列小岛与浅水通道组成。1494年第二次美洲航行期间，哥伦布从牙买加与克鲁斯角方向抵达，试图沿古巴海岸向西推进，却受到狭窄水道和密集沙洲岛屿的阻碍。他把这组岛屿称为“女王的花园”，使西班牙王室的称号进入远征记录中的地理命名。这次经历说明，从加勒比海的开阔海面驶近古巴南岸后，船只必须辨认迷宫般的浅滩与岛间通路，沿岸航行远非畅通无阻。欧洲命名之前，这里已属于有人生活往来的加勒比世界，但仅凭这段航海记述，不能确定各座小岛上原住民聚落的具体位置及沿革。

english:
Jardwajali country included parts of the Wimmera and the Gariwerd ranges of western Victoria, shared through relationships with neighbouring peoples including the Djab Wurrung. Tracks crossed the ranges between gathering places and culturally important sites. They were part of an inhabited landscape whose routes were already established when Thomas Mitchell's expedition entered in 1836.

Mitchell's party used some of these Aboriginal paths to travel through Gariwerd. His account also recorded a woven basket containing small fish, crayfish, snakes, rats and edible roots, a close glimpse of food gathering across several habitats. These observations show both the range of local resources and the infrastructure of Indigenous movement on the eve of extensive settler occupation. In the same journey, Mitchell applied the Scottish name Grampians to the ranges. The new name entered colonial maps, while the expedition's own progress had depended partly on paths made by the people whose country it traversed.
simp_chinese:
贾德瓦贾利人的土地包括维多利亚西部温默拉地区与加里韦尔德山地的部分区域，并通过与贾布武隆等邻近族群的关系相互连接。山中道路通往集会地点及具有文化意义的场所。1836年托马斯·米切尔探险队进入时，这片有人居住的土地已经拥有自己的交通路线。

米切尔一行借用部分原住民路径穿越加里韦尔德。他还记下一只编织篮中的食物，包括小鱼、螯虾、蛇、鼠与可食根茎，留下跨越多种生境采集食物的具体片段。这些观察呈现了大规模移民占地前夕的资源利用与交通网络。同一次旅程中，米切尔又以苏格兰山地之名，将这些山峰命名为格兰屏。新名称进入殖民地图，而探险队的通行，也部分依靠了当地居民开辟的道路。

english:
Jargalan belonged to the northern Khorasan frontier, where Safavid rulers relied on tribal commanders as well as town governors. Under Shah Abbas I, it was among the places where Chagatai and Bayat Turkmen groups from Khwarazm held senior military appointments. Its place in the kingdom was therefore tied to the deployment of particular families and their followers along the northeastern approaches.

This military geography formed part of a wider transformation of Khorasan during the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries. Safavid governments transferred Turkic and Kurdish communities from eastern Anatolia, Azerbaijan and the Caucasus, granting them pasture and cultivated land as a barrier against Uzbek attacks. Command, settlement and access to land were closely connected. Jargalan's early modern setting was a frontier maintained through these negotiated and imposed relationships between the dynasty and mobile tribal forces.
simp_chinese:
贾尔加兰位于呼罗珊北部边地，萨法维统治者在此既依靠城镇官员，也依靠部族将领。阿拔斯一世时期，这里是来自花剌子模的察合台人与巴亚特土库曼集团担任高级军职的地点之一。它在王国中的地位，因而与东北边疆特定家族及其追随者的部署相连。

这种军事布局属于十六、十七世纪呼罗珊更广泛的变化。萨法维政权从东安纳托利亚、阿塞拜疆与高加索迁移突厥、库尔德社区，授予牧场和耕地，以抵御乌兹别克袭击。军职、安置与土地权利紧密交织。贾尔加兰的近世环境，由王朝与流动部族武装之间既有协商、也有强制的关系维持。

english: Jargö Lake lies on the high plateau of northern Tibet, in the lake country of Changtang. Its Tibetan name is also rendered Qiagui Co in Chinese. The lake occupies an inland basin among the broad uplands and mountain ranges north of the Himalaya. Cold weather and the great elevation shape a landscape of open water and sparse vegetation, far from the great river valleys of southern Tibet.
simp_chinese: 嘉尔戈错位于藏北羌塘高原的湖泊地带，中文也称恰规错。湖水汇聚在喜马拉雅山以北广阔高地与山岭之间的内流盆地。海拔高、气候寒冷，这里的开阔水面和稀疏植被构成一种独特景观，与西藏南部的大河谷相距遥远。

english: Jariekhi lies in the northern Caucasus near the meeting of the Armkhi and Terek valleys, not far from the Darial Gorge. The Dzheyrakh people formed a mountain society in the gorge and along the lower Armkhi and upper Terek. The settlement's history is linked to the formation of that Ingush community around the turn of the seventeenth century. In 1745 the Georgian historian Vakhushti described the place in his geography, recording a mountain community whose valleys opened towards the great passage through the Caucasus.
simp_chinese: 贾列希位于北高加索阿尔姆希河谷与捷列克河谷交会处附近，离达里亚尔峡谷不远。杰拉赫人在峡谷及阿尔姆希河下游、捷列克河上游形成山地社群。聚落的历史与这一印古什社群约在十七世纪前后形成的过程相连。1745年，格鲁吉亚史家瓦赫什蒂在地理著作中记载了此地；这里的山谷通向穿越高加索的重要隘路。

english:
Jaroujiji is a Wiyot place-name for the land occupied by present-day Eureka on Humboldt Bay, meaning a place to stop and rest. It belonged to a wider Indigenous homeland extending along the bay and the lower Eel and Mad rivers. Waterways connected villages, fishing grounds and ceremonial places. Redwood canoes carried people through creeks and sloughs as well as across the bay.

Before settlers altered the wetlands, these channels supported access to shellfish, fish, eels and other foods. Tule and willow roots supplied materials for basketry and textiles, while water also served medicinal and ceremonial purposes. This was a lived and named landscape long before Eureka's colonial town developed. The Wiyot Tribe dates the first recorded European entry into Humboldt Bay to Captain Jonathan Winship in 1806, while sustained outsider contact began only after 1837. Jaroujiji's history during the period therefore belongs chiefly to Wiyot settlement, subsistence and movement around the bay.
simp_chinese:
贾鲁吉吉是维约特人对今洪堡湾尤里卡所在地的称呼，意为停下休息的地方。它属于沿海湾及鳗鱼河、马德河下游延伸的原住民家园。水道连接村落、渔场与仪式地点，红杉独木舟载人穿行于溪流、潮汊及海湾之间。

在定居者改变湿地以前，这些水道帮助居民获取贝类、鱼、鳗鱼及其他食物。蒲草与柳根提供编篮和纺织材料，水也用于医药及仪式。这片拥有地名与日常生活的景观，远早于殖民城镇尤里卡形成。维约特族将欧洲人首次有记录进入洪堡湾的时间记为1806年，船长是乔纳森·温希普，而持续的外来接触到1837年以后才开始。因此，这一时期贾鲁吉吉的历史主要属于维约特人的聚居、生计及湾区活动。

english:
The jarrah and karri country of southwestern Australia included Wadandi lands, where Indigenous communities lived long before European settlement. Dutch navigators rounded the southwestern cape in 1622 and called the region Leeuwin's Land. Passing ships gave new names to coastal landmarks, but sustained colonial occupation came much later.

In 1830 John Molloy led settlers to Augusta. The dense timber made clearing difficult and slowed their efforts. John Garrett Bussell searched farther north and obtained a grant near the Vasse in 1832, attracted by open, green country. In 1834 the Bussell brothers and other settlers moved there from Augusta; by 1835 people in Perth were calling the settlement Busselton. Fencing and cultivation encroached on Wadandi country, and relations deteriorated into disputes and violence. By the end of this period, the forest's northern approaches were becoming a contested frontier of colonial farming.
simp_chinese:
澳大利亚西南的贾拉桉与卡里桉林区包括瓦丹迪人的土地，原住民社群早在欧洲殖民者到来前便已生活于此。1622年荷兰航海者绕过西南海角，将这一带称为“鲁文之地”。过往船只为沿岸地标赋予了新名称，而持续的殖民占居则来得更晚。

1830年，约翰·莫洛伊带领殖民者在奥古斯塔落脚。浓密林木使清地十分困难，开发进展缓慢。约翰·加勒特·巴塞尔向北寻找更适宜的地方，受开阔绿地吸引，于1832年取得瓦斯一带的土地授予。1834年，巴塞尔兄弟等人从奥古斯塔迁往那里；到1835年，珀斯居民已称新聚落为巴瑟尔顿。围栏与耕地侵入瓦丹迪人的土地，双方关系恶化，发生争执与暴力。到这一时期末，森林北缘已成为殖民农业扩张中争夺激烈的地带。

english: The Jarrakan languages belong to a narrow belt of the Kimberley, extending northeast from the Fitzroy and Margaret rivers towards Cambridge Gulf. They include Gija and Miriwoong, spoken in neighbouring parts of the eastern Kimberley. Gija country encompasses the Durack Range and the headwaters of the Stony River, amid the rugged hills west of the Ord River.
simp_chinese: 贾拉坎语族分布在金伯利一条狭长地带，从菲茨罗伊河和玛格丽特河一带向东北延伸至剑桥湾。吉贾语和米里伍恩语都属于这一语族，分别在金伯利东部相邻的地区使用。吉贾人的土地包括杜拉克山脉与斯托尼河源头，位于奥德河以西的崎岖山地中。

english: Jarrarah lies in the dry interior of eastern Arabia, west of the Gulf coast. Its settlement belongs to the open country between the Najd plateau and the oases of the east, a landscape crossed by desert routes and broken by scattered wells and low ground. The contrast between the plateau and the coastal oasis belt gives this part of Arabia its distinctive geography.
simp_chinese: 贾拉拉位于阿拉伯东部的干旱内陆，在海湾海岸以西。聚落处在内志高原与东方绿洲之间的开阔地带，沙漠道路穿过其间，零散的井与低地分布在广阔旱地中。高原和沿海绿洲带之间的对比，构成了这一地区的地理特色。

english: Jaru country lies in the eastern Kimberley, around the upper Ord and Margaret rivers and the country east of Halls Creek. Its southern reaches approach Sturt Creek and the edge of the Great Sandy Desert. The Jaru are an Aboriginal people whose language and traditions connect them to this extensive inland country.
simp_chinese: 贾鲁人的土地位于金伯利东部，涵盖奥德河与玛格丽特河上游及霍尔斯克里克以东地区，南部接近斯特尔特溪和大沙沙漠边缘。贾鲁人是原住民族群，语言与传统将他们同广阔的内陆土地联系起来。

english:
Jashpur Nagar was the chief town of Jashpur, an upland state in the forested country adjoining Surguja. Its origin survives principally through dynastic traditions. The district's historical account describes Sujan Rai arriving at Khudia, the seat of a Dom ruler named Raibhan, and leading a revolt that established a new ruling house. The story places the transition around the middle of the eighteenth century, but its episodes should be understood as remembered origins rather than a securely documented medieval chronology.

Jashpur subsequently acknowledged the Bhonsles of Nagpur. The remembered tribute of twenty-one buffaloes gives a concrete expression of this subordinate relationship. A firmer political turning point came in 1818, when an agreement with Madhuji Bhonsla transferred the Surguja group of states to British authority. Jashpur was initially treated in some respects as a dependency of Surguja, through which tribute was paid, while otherwise being handled as a distinct territory. Its capital therefore stood within a small hill state whose ruling family retained a local domain while relations of tribute and supervision changed around it.
simp_chinese:
杰什布尔那加尔是杰什布尔邦的首府，位于毗邻苏尔古贾的森林高地。邦国起源主要通过王朝传统保存。地方历史记述苏詹·拉伊抵达多姆统治者赖班所在的库迪亚，领导反抗并建立新的统治家族。这一转变被置于十八世纪中叶前后，但故事中的具体情节属于传承下来的建国记忆，不能视为证据完备的中世纪编年。

此后，杰什布尔承认那格浦尔邦斯莱家族的宗主地位。传统所记的二十一头水牛贡品，为这种从属关系提供了具体细节。更明确的政治转折出现在1818年，与马杜吉·邦斯莱订立的协议把苏尔古贾诸邦转交英国控制。杰什布尔起初在若干方面被当作苏尔古贾的附属领地，经由后者缴纳贡赋；其他事务则作为独立地域处理。因此，首府所代表的是一个保有地方领地的高地小邦，其外部贡赋与监督关系随周围势力变化而调整。

english:
Jäskis, or Jääski, lay beside the Vuoksi River on the Karelian Isthmus. It was named in the Treaty of Nöteborg in 1323 as one of the districts transferred from Novgorod to Sweden. The medieval district extended beyond the later town, including areas that subsequently formed several separate parishes.

The Great Northern War brought a new division. Under the Treaty of Nystad in 1721, the southern part of the Jääski district passed to the Russian Empire. The settlement became part of Vyborg province, which was incorporated into the Grand Duchy of Finland in 1812. These changes placed the same river community within successive Swedish, Russian and Finnish administrative frameworks. Its historical name therefore refers to a larger parish landscape as well as the particular settlement now known as Lesogorsky.
simp_chinese:
耶斯基斯又称耶斯基，位于卡累利阿地峡的沃克西河畔。1323年《内特堡条约》将它列为诺夫哥罗德转交瑞典的地区之一。中世纪辖区比后来的城镇更广，涵盖此后分立为数个教区的土地。

大北方战争带来新的分界。1721年《尼斯塔德条约》规定，耶斯基辖区南部归入俄罗斯帝国。聚落隶属维堡省，而该省于1812年并入芬兰大公国。这些变化使同一河畔社群先后处于瑞典、俄国及芬兰的行政体系之下。因此，历史上的耶斯基既指广阔教区地域，也指今称列索戈尔斯基的具体聚落。

english: Jasło grew in the southern part of Lesser Poland, in the old castellany of Biecz. Its lands belonged to the Cistercian abbey of Koprzywnica, and a local fair was held here by the middle of the thirteenth century. Casimir the Great granted the settlement Magdeburg rights in 1366. Two years later he exchanged other properties with the monks to bring Jasło into royal possession. The town already had a parish church and school, and Carmelite friars also settled there in the fourteenth century.
simp_chinese: 亚斯沃兴起于小波兰南部，属于古老的别奇城堡辖区。土地曾归科普日夫尼察的熙笃会修道院所有，到十三世纪中叶这里已有地方集市。1366年，卡齐米日大帝授予聚落马格德堡法权。两年后，他与修士交换其他地产，使亚斯沃成为王室城镇。当地已有教区教堂和学校，十四世纪加尔默罗会修士也来到这里定居。

english:
Jászberény stands on the Zagyva in the Jászság, the land of the Jász people on the Hungarian plain. Berény became the seat of their district, whose communities enjoyed distinctive privileges. A Franciscan church and monastery were built here in 1472, in the fifteenth century; during Ottoman rule the monastery was turned into an Ottoman military post.

In 1702 the Jász and Cuman districts were sold by the Habsburg crown, placing their inhabitants under a new landlord despite their long-established collective liberties. The communities gathered money and petitioned to recover their rights. In 1745 Maria Theresa approved their collective redemption, restoring much of their former privileged status. Jászberény, where the petition had been drawn up, remained the administrative centre of the restored Jász district.
simp_chinese:
亚斯贝雷尼位于匈牙利平原的扎吉沃河畔，是亚斯人的亚斯沙格地区的一部分。贝雷尼成为该地区的中心，当地社群享有特殊特权。1472年这里建起方济各会教堂和修道院；奥斯曼统治期间，修道院被改作军事据点。

1702年，哈布斯堡王室出售亚斯和库曼地区，使居民尽管拥有旧日自由，仍被置于领主之下。各社群筹集资金并请求恢复权利。1745年，玛丽亚·特蕾西亚批准他们集体赎回领地，恢复了大部分原有特权。起草请愿书的亚斯贝雷尼继续作为亚斯地区的行政中心。

english:
The lower Tibagi flows through the forested north of Paraná toward the Paranapanema. The country around the mouth of the Jataí was inhabited by Indigenous communities before the establishment of later colonial settlements. The river and its tributaries cross a landscape of wooded valleys and uplands, forming part of the great Paraná basin that drains much of southern Brazil.

The later city of Londrina lies here.
simp_chinese:
蒂巴吉河下游流经巴拉那北部的森林地区，流向帕拉纳帕内马河。在后来的殖民聚落建立之前，雅塔伊河口周围已有原住民社区居住。河流及其支流穿过森林河谷与高地，属于为巴西南部广大地区排水的巴拉那河大流域。

后来的隆德里纳即位于此地。

english:
Jath became the seat of the Dafle chiefs in the upheavals surrounding Bijapur's fall. Satvajirao, from the headman's family of Daphlapur, served the Bijapur court and held hereditary revenue authority over Jath and neighbouring divisions. After Aurangzeb conquered Bijapur in 1686, he entered Mughal service and secured confirmation of his holdings, together with a cavalry command. His family took the name Dafle from its original village.

Later rulers participated in the Maratha political world. Khanajirao fought at Kharda in 1795, while Renukabai subsequently governed the estate. In 1820 she entered agreements with the British government and the Raja of Satara. Succession remained precarious: after her death the estate reverted to Satara, was restored to the collateral heir Ramrao in 1824, and was attached again when he died childless in 1835. Jath's authority rested on service and hereditary claims that stronger powers could confirm or withdraw.
simp_chinese:
杰特在比贾普尔覆亡前后的动荡中，成为达夫勒首领的治所。来自达夫拉普尔村长家族的萨特瓦吉拉奥曾服务比贾普尔宫廷，对杰特及邻近地区享有世袭税收职权。1686年，奥朗则布征服比贾普尔后，他转入莫卧儿服役，取得领地确认及骑兵统领职位；家族以原籍村名为达夫勒姓号。

后来的统治者参与马拉塔政治。卡纳吉拉奥于1795年参加哈尔达之战，雷努卡拜随后治理领地，1820年与英国政府及萨塔拉君主订立协议。继承关系并不稳定：她去世后领地归回萨塔拉，1824年交还旁系继承人拉姆拉奥，1835年后者无子去世，领地又被接管。杰特的权威依靠服役与世袭主张，也取决于较强权力的承认。

english:
Játiva, or Xàtiva, became one of the leading towns of the Kingdom of Valencia after James I conquered it in 1244, respecting its mosque and making it the capital of the district south of the Xúquer, as the Júcar is called in Valencian. In 1250 he gave it the right to hold a trade fair. Peter IV granted Xàtiva city status and a royal banner in 1347 for its loyalty to the king in the War of the Union. Its castle on the ridge above the town was the state prison of the kings of Aragon, and the Borja family, from Xàtiva, gave the church two popes, Calixtus III and Alexander VI.

The painter José de Ribera, born here in 1591, made his career in Naples. The expulsion of the Moriscos in 1609 and the plague of 1645 hit the town hard. In the War of the Spanish Succession, Xàtiva held for the Habsburg claimant, and in 1707 Philip V's troops burned it and renamed it San Felipe.
simp_chinese:
哈蒂瓦在海梅一世1244年征服它之后，成为巴伦西亚王国的主要城镇之一；国王保留了清真寺，并使它成为胡卡尔河以南地区的首府，1250年又赐予它举办集市的权利。1347年，因在联合战争中忠于国王，佩德罗四世授予哈蒂瓦城市地位和王家旗帜。城堡位于镇子上方的山脊上，是阿拉贡国王的国家监狱；博尔哈家族出自此地，出了两位教皇，加里斯都三世和亚历山大六世。

画家何塞·德·里贝拉1591年生于此地，后来在那不勒斯成名。1609年驱逐摩里斯科人和1645年的瘟疫给城镇以沉重打击。西班牙王位继承战争中，哈蒂瓦站在哈布斯堡一方，1707年腓力五世的军队焚毁该城并将其改名为圣费利佩。

english: Jaund appears in historical writing as Chaund, a pargana in the country of Shahabad in Bihar. A study of Mughal geography identifies its name with Chand and places its area within the later pargana of Chainpur. In the early sixteenth century, Muhammad Khan Sur held Chaund and became involved in the family disputes of Farid, the future Sher Shah. After Farid obtained recognition of his inheritance, his half-brother Sulaiman sought refuge with Muhammad Khan, who proposed dividing the family assignment. Farid resisted surrendering its administration. The episode places Chaund within a network of Afghan chiefs, revenue assignments and competing family interests before the establishment of Sher Shah’s empire.
simp_chinese: Jaund 在历史著述中亦写作 Chaund，是比哈尔沙哈巴德一带的一个帕尔加纳税区。一篇研究莫卧儿地理的论文，将其名称与 Chand 联系起来，并将其地域置于后来的柴恩普尔税区之内。十六世纪初，穆罕默德汗·苏尔掌握 Chaund，并卷入法里德、即后来的舍尔沙与家人的继承争执。法里德获得对父亲领地的承认后，其异母兄弟苏莱曼投奔穆罕默德汗；后者提出分割家族领地，法里德则拒绝交出其行政管辖权。这一事件将当地置于阿富汗首领、税收封地和家族竞争的网络之中。

sources.title: 1885 Journal Asiatic Society of Bengal Vol 54 Part 1 s.pdf

english:
Jaunpur became the capital of the Sharqi sultans during the fragmentation of Delhi's authority in the late fourteenth century. Malik Sarwar, invested with the title Malik al-Sharq and authority over eastern territories, established his court here. His successors made the city a centre of royal patronage, religious architecture and learning.

Ibrahim Shah completed the Atala Mosque in 1408. Other monumental mosques, including the Friday Mosque associated with Husain Shah, gave the fifteenth-century capital a distinctive architectural character. Sharqi rule ended through prolonged conflict with the Lodi sultans, whose control was consolidated in the later fifteenth century. Jaunpur subsequently belonged to the Mughal political world; the royal bridge across the Gomti was constructed during Akbar's reign. In 1722 the district passed to the nawab of Awadh. Changes in sovereignty thus left successive marks on a city whose monuments preserved the ambitions of its independent sultans.
simp_chinese:
十四世纪末，德里权威分化，章普尔成为沙尔基苏丹的都城。马利克·萨尔瓦尔获授“东方之王”称号及东部领土的管辖权，在此建立宫廷。继承者通过王室赞助，使城市成为宗教建筑与学术活动的中心。

1408年，易卜拉欣沙完成阿塔拉清真寺。与侯赛因沙相连的聚礼清真寺等宏伟建筑，也赋予十五世纪都城鲜明面貌。沙尔基统治在同洛迪苏丹的长期冲突中结束，洛迪于十五世纪后期巩固控制。章普尔随后进入莫卧儿政治体系，阿克巴在位时兴建跨越贡提河的皇家桥梁。1722年，该区转归阿瓦德纳瓦布。主权更替接连改变城市，而苏丹时代的纪念建筑继续保存独立王朝的雄心。

english: Jauregui lies in the mountains of western Venezuela, at the site of La Grita. Valleys and steep slopes connect this Andean country with routes toward Mérida and the lands farther south. In 1576 the Spanish captain Francisco de Cáceres founded the city of Espíritu Santo de La Grita. It became a centre for a colonial jurisdiction in a region where Indigenous communities had already established their own settlements and routes through the mountains.
simp_chinese: 豪雷吉位于委内瑞拉西部山区，即拉格里塔所在地。河谷与陡坡将这片安第斯地区同通往梅里达及更南方土地的道路连接起来。1576年，西班牙上尉弗朗西斯科·德卡塞雷斯建立圣灵－德拉格里塔城。它成为殖民辖区的中心；在此之前，原住民社群已在山地间建立聚落和道路。

english: Jaurúa lay in the Uco country east of the Andes, among the valleys and grazing lands south of Mendoza. Indigenous Huarpe communities inhabited the region before Spanish settlement. In the colonial period, estates in the Uco valley raised cattle, and the area became a meeting place for Indigenous peoples from the mountains and the plains. After 1660, groups identified as Chiquillanes and Pampas were moved into the valley under arrangements involving the colonial authorities.
simp_chinese: 豪鲁阿位于安第斯山以东的乌科地区，处在门多萨以南的河谷与牧地之间。西班牙人定居以前，瓦尔佩原住民社群已居住于此。殖民时期，乌科谷地的庄园饲养牛群，这片地区也成为山地与平原原住民的交会之地。1660年后，被称为奇基利亚内人和潘帕人的群体，在殖民当局参与的安排下迁入谷地。

english: Jáutok is the Kawésqar name for the inner-channel side of their maritime territory in western Patagonia. Here sheltered waters wind between steep coasts and islands, in contrast to the rougher outer sea known as Málte. The Kawésqar navigated this intricate country by canoe, choosing routes and camps according to the coast, weather and resources sought. Knowledge of the difference between the inner passages and the exposed ocean was essential to travel.
simp_chinese: 焦托克是卡韦斯卡尔人对巴塔哥尼亚西部海洋领地内侧水道地区的称呼。受遮蔽的水域在陡峭海岸与岛屿之间蜿蜒，与称为马尔特的汹涌外海形成对照。卡韦斯卡尔人乘独木舟穿行于这片复杂地带，依照海岸、天气和所寻找的资源选择航路与营地。了解内水道与暴露外海的区别，是旅行的重要知识。

english:
The Java Sea off Surabaya lay between eastern Java, Madura and the routes towards Borneo and the eastern archipelago. Monsoon winds set the rhythm of longer voyages, while coastal craft carried provisions between neighbouring ports. Rice from Java's agricultural hinterland was a vital cargo in exchange with the spice-producing islands; timber and shipbuilding supported this seaborne economy.

During the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries, Majapahit's inland wealth was joined to these north-coast trading connections. Muslim port communities subsequently grew in influence, and Surabaya emerged as a powerful coastal state with allies across the sea. Sultan Agung's conquest in 1625 required the defeat of its allies and the isolation of the city, bringing this stretch of coast under Mataram. In 1743 the Dutch East India Company acquired Surabaya from the weakened kingdom. The succession of rulers altered customs, obligations and the balance of naval power, but the waters remained a route for regional shipping as well as company vessels. Here the movement of food, crews and building materials sustained the ports from which rulers attempted to control the wider Java Sea.
simp_chinese:
泗水外海的爪哇海联系东爪哇、马都拉，以及通往婆罗洲和群岛东部的航路。季风决定远航节奏，沿岸小船则在相邻港口间运输给养。爪哇农业腹地产出的稻米，是与香料产区交换的重要货物；木材供应与造船业也支撑着这套海运经济。

十四至十五世纪，满者伯夷的内陆财富与北岸贸易网络相连。此后穆斯林港口社群壮大，泗水成为拥有海外盟友的强大沿海政权。1625年，苏丹阿贡先击败其盟友，再隔绝城池，终于征服泗水，将这段海岸纳入马打蓝。1743年，荷兰东印度公司从衰弱的马打蓝取得泗水。统治者更替改变了税关、役务与海军力量的分布，区域船运仍与公司船只共同往来。粮食、船员和建筑材料不断流入沿海港口，维持城市生活，也为企图控制爪哇海的王国与商贸公司提供物质基础。

english:
The Java Sea off Surabaya connected eastern Java with Madura, southern Borneo and the routes toward Maluku. In the early seventeenth century Surabaya was a powerful maritime city, supported by alliances with other Javanese ports and with Sukadana and Banjarmasin across the sea. Its commercial position gave overseas connections a direct part in the struggle for power on Java.

Sultan Agung of Mataram attacked Surabaya's allies before overcoming the city itself. Tuban fell in 1619, Sukadana in 1622 and Madura in 1624. Repeated expeditions against Surabaya from 1620 met difficulties supplying Mataram's troops, while the loss of the city's allies progressively weakened its own access to provisions. The final siege in 1625 brought shortages of food and water and forced surrender. These waters therefore carried the connections on which a besieged port depended. In the eighteenth century Surabaya passed into the Dutch East India Company's control, adding a new authority to a coast already shaped by commerce, alliances and the contest between port and inland kingdom.
simp_chinese:
泗水外的爪哇海连接东爪哇、马都拉、南婆罗洲及通往马鲁古的航路。十七世纪初，泗水是强大的海上城市，与爪哇其他港口，以及海对岸苏卡达纳、班贾尔马辛结盟。海外联系因其商业地位而直接参与爪哇权力竞争。

马打蓝苏丹阿贡先攻泗水盟友，再迫使城市屈服：图班于1619年陷落，苏卡达纳在1622年失守，马都拉则于1624年被征服。1620年起的数次围攻中，马打蓝军队也遇到补给困难；与此同时，盟友陆续失去，使泗水粮源愈益缩减。1625年最后围城造成缺粮缺水，迫使泗水投降。外海由此承载着被围港口赖以维持的联系。十八世纪，泗水归入荷兰东印度公司控制，商业、联盟及内陆王国争夺塑造的海岸又增添新权威。

english: The Java Sea extends between the northern coast of Java and southern Borneo. Its shallow waters contain islands and reefs, and connect westward to the Sunda Strait and eastward to the seas around Sulawesi. On the Javanese shore, Surabaya stands near the mouth of the Brantas river system. Monsoon winds change with the seasons, influencing movement across the sea between the ports and islands of the archipelago.
simp_chinese: 爪哇海横亘于爪哇北岸与婆罗洲南岸之间。浅海中分布岛屿和珊瑚礁，西通巽他海峡，东接苏拉威西周围海域。爪哇海岸上的苏腊巴亚靠近布兰塔斯河水系的河口。季风随季节转换，影响群岛港口和岛屿之间的海上往来。

english: The Java Sea washes the northern coast of Java, where lowlands and river mouths face the shallow waters between Java and Borneo. Ports such as Cirebon grew along this shore, drawing on connections with the island's interior and the maritime routes across the sea. In the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries Cirebon emerged as an Islamic centre on the Javanese coast.
simp_chinese: 爪哇海冲刷着爪哇北岸，低地和河口面向爪哇与婆罗洲之间的浅海。井里汶等港口沿岸兴起，依靠与岛屿内陆及海上航路的联系发展。十五至十六世纪，井里汶成为爪哇海岸上的伊斯兰中心。

english:
The Java Sea approaches to Cirebon connected the port with Batavia and the maritime commerce of Java's northern coast. In 1681 Cirebon's rulers entered an alliance with the Dutch East India Company. The same year the company began operating Fort Bescherming at the port, initially a modest bamboo stockade.

The fort was more than a defence against attack. It served as a political office through which the company sought to hold the Cirebon sultans to their agreement, and it underwent repeated renovations. Correspondence between Batavia and the three Cirebon rulers in 1680–1682 records the diplomacy accompanying this new relationship. For ships approaching Cirebon, the shore therefore presented a port increasingly shaped by company power and negotiations with several courts, rather than a single undivided sultanate.
simp_chinese:
井里汶近海的爪哇海水域，将这座港口与巴达维亚及爪哇北岸的海上贸易联系起来。1681年，井里汶诸统治者与荷兰东印度公司结盟。同年，公司开始在港口使用贝斯赫明堡，最初只是一座简陋的竹木围栅。

堡垒除了军事防守，还充当政治办事机构，公司借此要求井里汶苏丹遵守协议，并数次改修设施。1680至1682年巴达维亚与井里汶三位统治者之间的通信，记录了这一新关系伴随的外交交涉。对驶近井里汶的船只而言，岸上港口日益受到公司势力及其与多个宫廷协商的影响。

english:
The waters off Cirebon connected Java's northern coast with Batavia and the wider Java Sea. Cirebon's courts stood behind a port whose overseas relationships became increasingly entangled with the Dutch East India Company. Surviving correspondence records exchanges between Cirebon and Batavia in the 1670s and 1680s, when the Company's influence over the port was growing.

The treaty of 1705 transferred Mataram's claims over Cirebon to the Company, confirming a position already built through earlier agreements. Dutch residents acquired influence over the port's trade and over produce coming from the interior. Rice, sugar, pepper and other agricultural goods linked the coastal trading place with its hinterland. The sea before Cirebon consequently formed the maritime edge of a changing political economy: local rulers remained involved in government, while Company officials sought to direct commerce and deliveries. This history belongs to the Cirebon coast bordering these waters.
simp_chinese:
井里汶外海连接爪哇北岸、巴达维亚与更广阔的爪哇海。港口背后有井里汶诸宫廷，其对外关系逐渐受到荷兰东印度公司影响。留存书信记录了1670至1680年代井里汶与巴达维亚之间的往来，当时公司正加强对港口的介入。

1705年的条约将马打蓝对井里汶的权利要求转交公司，确认了此前多项协议已经形成的局面。荷兰驻扎官逐步掌握港口贸易及内陆物产的控制权。稻米、糖、胡椒等农产品把沿海交易地点与腹地相连。井里汶面前的海域因而成为地方政治经济变化的海上边缘：本地统治者仍参与治理，公司官员则试图控制商业与物产交纳。这段历史属于毗邻水域的井里汶海岸，港口和腹地的联系共同塑造了海上往来的条件。

english: The Java Sea is a shallow tropical sea between Java and Borneo, crossed by routes linking the islands of the Indonesian archipelago. Along Java’s northern shore, river mouths and coastal towns face its waters, while islands and reefs lie farther offshore. Seasonal monsoon winds influence sailing conditions and currents. The sea joins the waters of the Sunda Strait to the west and the straits leading eastwards through the islands.
simp_chinese: 爪哇海是爪哇与婆罗洲之间的热带浅海，连接印度尼西亚群岛的航路横穿其间。爪哇北岸的河口和沿海城镇面向大海，较远处散布岛屿与珊瑚礁。季风随季节变化，影响航行条件和海流；爪哇海西接巽他海峡，东通群岛之间的诸水道。

english:
Javad stood near the confluence of the Kura and Aras, where a crossing joined the roads of Shirvan to those leading south into Iran. Travelers described a settlement with gardens, houses of brick and reeds, and craftsmen producing carpets and silk fabrics. A bridge of boats chained together carried traffic across the river; the English merchant Anthony Jenkinson visited the palace of Shirvan's governor here in the sixteenth century.

Javad remained a substantial settlement in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries and became the center of a small khanate. Its position at the crossing also exposed it to war. In 1778 Hidayat Khan of Gilan attacked Javad, captured its ruler Hasan Khan and carried inhabitants away towards Rasht. The town was devastated and did not recover its former standing.
simp_chinese:
贾瓦德位于库拉河与阿拉斯河汇合处附近，渡口将希尔凡的道路与南通伊朗的道路连接起来。旅行者描述这里有花园、砖苇建造的房屋，以及制作地毯和丝织品的工匠。以铁链相连的船桥供人渡河；十六世纪，英国商人安东尼·詹金森曾在此拜访希尔凡总督的宫邸。

十七、十八世纪，贾瓦德仍是规模可观的聚落，并成为一个小汗国的中心。渡口的位置也使它容易受到战火波及。1778年，吉兰的希达亚特汗进攻贾瓦德，俘虏其统治者哈桑汗，并将居民掳往拉什特方向。城镇遭到严重破坏，未能恢复昔日地位。

english:
Javaes lies in the uplands of southern Goiás, near the basin of the Meia Ponte. Rising in the Serra dos Brandões, the Meia Ponte flows south to join the Paranaíba, part of the Paraná system. The rolling plateau is cut by tributary valleys and small floodplains, while the neighbouring basin of the Rio dos Bois lies to the west.

The later city of Goiânia lies here.
simp_chinese:
雅瓦埃斯位于戈亚斯南部高地，靠近梅亚蓬特河流域。梅亚蓬特河发源于布兰东斯山，向南汇入巴拉那河水系的帕拉纳伊巴河。支流河谷和小片泛滥平原切开起伏的台地，西面则是相邻的博伊斯河流域。

后来的戈亚尼亚即位于此地。

english: The mountains of western Java rise between the northern lowlands and the island’s southern coast. Volcanic peaks, forested slopes and river valleys give the interior a rugged character, while streams descend towards the Java Sea and the Indian Ocean. The highlands form part of the Sundanese country, where mountains separate neighbouring valleys across a narrow but mountainous island.
simp_chinese: 西爪哇山地耸立在北部低地与岛屿南岸之间。火山、森林山坡和河谷构成崎岖的内陆地貌，溪流分别流向爪哇海与印度洋。高地属于巽他地区，山岭将相邻河谷分隔开来，形成这座狭长而多山岛屿的内部景观。

english: The mountains of central Java include the neighbouring volcanic cones of Sundoro and Sumbing, rising between the Dieng highlands and the Kedu plain. A gap between the peaks carried an old route from Kedu toward Wonosobo and Dieng. In the late fifteenth-century Sundanese account of Bujangga Manik, Dieng, Sindara and Kedu appear as inhabited holy mountains. Their slopes and the valleys between them formed part of the landscape of the early kingdom of Mataram.
simp_chinese: 爪哇中部群山包括相邻的松多罗和松宾火山锥，耸立在迪昂高地与克杜平原之间。两山之间的隘口有一条古道，从克杜通往沃诺索博和迪昂。十五世纪末的巽他文献《布让加·马尼克》将迪昂、辛达拉和克杜记作有人居住的圣山。这些山坡与山间河谷曾是早期马打兰王国疆域的一部分。

english:
These Javanese mountains lie near the Trowulan region of eastern Java. Volcanic slopes, forests and streams form part of the wider landscape around the cultivated plains.

During the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries, the wider region was part of the world of Majapahit, whose court was centred on the eastern Javanese plain. As Majapahit declined, coastal Muslim powers and inland successors reshaped Java's political geography.
simp_chinese:
爪哇山地位于东爪哇多乌兰地区附近。火山坡地、森林和溪流构成耕作平原周围的广阔景观。

十四、十五世纪，更广大地区属于满者伯夷的世界，其宫廷以东爪哇平原为中心。满者伯夷衰落后，沿海穆斯林势力与内陆继承政权重塑爪哇政治格局。

english:
Javanrud lay in the Kurdish highlands close to the Ottoman-Persian frontier. Historically it was one of the rural districts of Ardalan, whose authority extended through a network of local chiefs. The area's importance came partly from this border position, where the interests of regional rulers intersected with those of larger imperial powers.

It was also a homeland of the Jaf. According to the account summarised in Encyclopaedia Iranica, a battle with the governor of Ardalan late in the seventeenth century ended with the capture and killing of a Jaf leader and his son. Much of the group then moved into Ottoman territory near Sulaymaniyah, while those who stayed became known as the Jaf of Javanrud. In the Ottoman occupation of Iranian Kurdistan during the 1720s, Cevanrud appeared among the districts registered under Ardalan. These episodes show that the frontier ran through existing communities: warfare changed jurisdictions and encouraged migration, while kinship connected people who subsequently lived on different sides.
simp_chinese:
贾万鲁德位于库尔德山地，靠近奥斯曼与波斯之间的边疆。历史上它是阿尔达兰的乡村区之一，区域权力经由地方首领网络展开。这个位置使它具有特别意义，地方统治者的利益在这里与更大的帝国势力相交。

这里也是贾夫人的家园。《伊朗百科全书》概述的记载称，十七世纪末贾夫人与阿尔达兰总督交战，一位首领及其儿子被俘杀。部落大部随后迁往奥斯曼境内的苏莱曼尼亚一带，留居者则称贾万鲁德贾夫人。十八世纪二十年代，奥斯曼占据伊朗库尔德地区时，杰万鲁德又出现在阿尔达兰属区的登记中。这些经历说明，边疆穿过的是原有社群：战争改变辖属，并推动人口迁徙；亲缘关系仍将后来分居两侧的人联系起来。

english: Jawan is a recorded name for northwestern groups of the Kalamaia people, north of Mukinbudin in Western Australia. Kalamaia country extends across the inland Wheatbelt and Goldfields. The name distinguishes one part of a wider Aboriginal homeland of dry plains and woodlands, where neighbouring communities used different names for people and places.
simp_chinese: 贾万是西澳大利亚穆金布丁以北卡拉迈亚人西北部群体的记载名称。卡拉迈亚人的土地横跨内陆麦田区与金矿区。这个名称区分了广阔原住民家园的一部分；当地干旱平原和林地间的邻近社群对人群和地点使用不同名称。

english: Jawand lies in the high country of Badghis, where a valley descends toward the Murghab River. The Jawand stream follows the valley northwest to meet the river, while a route leads in the opposite direction toward the Hari Rud watershed. These valleys cut through the uplands between the Murghab and Hari Rud, joining their mountain surroundings to the river corridors below.
simp_chinese: 贾万德位于巴德吉斯高地，一条山谷向穆尔加布河方向下降。贾万德溪沿谷地向西北汇入穆尔加布河，反方向的道路则通往哈里河分水岭。山谷切穿两条河流之间的高地，把周围山区与下方河道连接起来。

sources.title: 1975 Historical and Political Gazetteer of Afghanistan Vol 3 Herat and NW Afghanistan s.pdf

english:
Jawhar was the capital of a small hill state in the country now forming Maharashtra's Palghar district. Its ruling tradition associated recognition by the Delhi sultan with 1343, a date important enough to serve as the beginning of a local era in public documents. Accounts differ over the founder's name and the sequence of events before this recognition, but agree that the Mukne dynasty made Jawhar its seat.

The official census town survey preserves a fuller dynastic tradition, describing struggles with the Delhi sultanate and the Bahmani rulers. These stories present the hill state as maintaining its position through warfare, recognition and relations with stronger neighbors. By the early nineteenth century it was dealing with British authority in western India; the survey records a coronation associated with Governor Elphinstone in 1826. Jawhar's history joins the continuity of a local ruling house with repeated adjustments to the larger powers surrounding its hill territory.
simp_chinese:
乔哈尔是今马哈拉施特拉邦帕尔加尔地区一个山地小邦的都城。当地王统传说将德里苏丹承认统治者地位的事件系于1343年；这一日期甚至成为地方公文所用纪年的起点。关于更早的创建过程和创始人，现有官方介绍并不完全一致，但都将乔哈尔与穆克内王朝的统治联系起来。

官方人口普查城镇调查保存了更完整的王统叙述，包括同德里苏丹和巴赫马尼统治者的争战。这些故事呈现山地政权如何通过战争、册认及与强邻建立关系维持地位。十九世纪初，乔哈尔又与印度西部的英国当局发生联系；调查资料记载1826年的一次加冕与总督埃尔芬斯通有关。地方王朝的延续，因而伴随着周边大国更替所带来的调整。

english:
Jawor lies on the Nysa Szalona in Lower Silesia. Once a fortified settlement, it became the capital of a Piast duchy in 1274 and grew into an important centre of weaving. Stone walls enclosed the town, while merchants, clothiers, tailors and furriers formed guilds. Duke Henry I granted it a staple right in 1329, strengthening its position in trade.

The duchy was united with Świdnica in 1346 and remained under Piast rule until 1392. Jawor suffered repeated occupation, plunder and disease during the Thirty Years' War. After the Peace of Westphalia, its Protestant community was permitted to build a Church of Peace, despite the restrictions imposed by the Habsburg authorities. The town later passed to Prussia, which turned the old Piast castle into a prison.
simp_chinese:
亚沃尔位于下西里西亚的尼萨沙洛纳河畔。它原是一座设防聚落，1274年成为皮雅斯特王朝一个公国的首府，并发展为重要的纺织中心。石墙环绕城镇，商人、制呢匠、裁缝和毛皮匠组成行会。1329年，亨利克一世公爵授予当地货物停留权，巩固了城镇的贸易地位。

亚沃尔公国于1346年与希维德尼察合并，直到1392年仍由皮雅斯特家族统治。三十年战争期间，城镇屡遭占领、劫掠和疫病侵袭。威斯特伐利亚和约之后，尽管哈布斯堡当局施加种种限制，当地新教徒仍获准兴建一座和平教堂。亚沃尔后来归属普鲁士，旧皮雅斯特城堡被改作监狱。

english:
Jawoyn country on the Arnhem Land plateau included Nawarla Gabarnmang, a rockshelter where generations added images to ceilings and walls. Beeswax figures there belong to the fifteenth through early seventeenth centuries: two have calibrated radiocarbon ranges spanning approximately 1433–1631. Earlier paintings lay beneath them, and later artists painted over the wax, leaving visible layers of renewed work.

On one ceiling panel, successive images retained many of the same subjects while their colours changed. White pigment and white-based two-colour painting became more prominent than red and red-based combinations. Figures, animals and designs accumulated on surfaces already meaningful to earlier generations. The shelter was therefore an active setting for artistic work during the centuries before nineteenth-century European contact. Its layered images preserve both continuity in chosen subjects and changes in how Jawoyn artists presented them.
simp_chinese:
贾沃因人在阿纳姆地高原的领地中，包括纳瓦拉加巴恩芒岩棚。世代居民不断在棚顶和岩壁增添图像。其中两个人工蜂蜡图形的放射性碳校正年代，约落在1433至1631年之间。更早绘画位于蜡层之下，后来的画者又覆盖其上，留下反复创作的叠层。

一处棚顶画面中，连续图像的题材多有延续，色彩却发生变化：白色颜料和以白色为主的双色画，逐渐比红色及以红色为主的组合更突出。人物、动物与纹样，累积在早已承载前人意义的表面。因此，在十九世纪欧洲接触以前的数百年间，岩棚始终是活跃的艺术创作场所。层叠图像同时保存了题材延续与表现方式变化。

english: Jayankondam lies in the Chola country of Tamil Nadu, close to the former royal city of Gangaikonda Cholapuram. Rajendra I founded that city and its great Shiva temple in the eleventh century to commemorate his northern victories. The temple’s towering sanctuary endured after the Chola court ceased to rule from the city. Jayankondam and neighbouring Udayarpalayam stand within the cultivated country surrounding this remarkable monument of Chola power.
simp_chinese: 贾扬孔达姆位于泰米尔地区的朱罗故地，靠近昔日王城恒伽贡达朱罗布勒姆。十一世纪，罗贞陀罗一世兴建这座城市及宏伟的湿婆神庙，以纪念北方征战。朱罗王廷不再从这里统治之后，高耸的神庙仍然屹立。贾扬孔达姆与邻近的乌代亚尔帕莱亚姆坐落在这座朱罗权力纪念碑周围的耕作地区。

english: Jaynagar grew in the lowlands of southern Bengal near the old course of the Adi Ganga. Local accounts describe a settlement formed as wooded land was cleared, with landholding families establishing themselves beside the river. The neighbouring settlement of Majilpur also developed along its channel. The changing course and silting of this branch of the Ganges left the two places within a landscape shaped by waterways and reclaimed land.
simp_chinese: 杰纳加尔兴起于孟加拉南部低地，靠近阿迪恒河的旧河道。地方记载称，居民砍伐林地开辟聚落，地主家族在河边定居；邻近的马吉尔布尔也沿着这条水道发展。恒河支流改道和淤积，使两处聚落所处的景观不断受到水道变化与土地开垦的影响。

english: Jayrud lies on the eastern slopes of the Qalamoun, northeast of Damascus, beside a broad plain that gives way to the Syrian steppe. The salt flat of al-Mallahah lies near the town, a conspicuous white expanse in the dry season. Its fields have drawn on wells and channels, while sheep and goats graze in the surrounding country. The geographer Yaqut knew the settlement as Jarud; the salt deposits and ancient remains around the basin speak to a longer history of human occupation at the edge of the desert.
simp_chinese: 杰鲁德位于大马士革东北的卡拉蒙山东坡，旁边是一片逐渐过渡为叙利亚草原的广阔平原。城镇附近的马拉哈盐沼在旱季呈现醒目的白色。当地田地利用井水与渠道灌溉，羊群则在周围放牧。地理学家雅库特曾以贾鲁德之名记述此地；盆地周围的盐矿和古代遗址，见证了人们在沙漠边缘的漫长居住历史。

english: Al Jaza'ir lies in the dry country of the Jazira, the broad land between the Euphrates and the Tigris. Away from the rivers, plains and steppe stretch across northern Mesopotamia towards the Syrian desert. The Euphrates valley cuts through this arid landscape, its course marking a contrast between the river corridor and the open country beyond.
simp_chinese: 杰扎伊尔位于干旱的杰济拉地区，即幼发拉底河与底格里斯河之间的广大土地。远离河流之处，平原和草原横贯美索不达米亚北部，伸向叙利亚沙漠。幼发拉底河谷切穿旱地，河流走廊与周围开阔地区形成鲜明对照。

english: Jazan stands on the Red Sea coast of the Tihama, facing the Farasan Islands. The coastal plain links the highlands of Yemen and Asir with the shore and the routes leading north toward the Hijaz. Its position placed Jazan on a corridor used by travellers between Yemen and the holy cities, while the sea connected its people with the islands offshore.
simp_chinese: 吉赞位于提哈马的红海海岸，面向法拉桑群岛。沿海平原将也门与阿西尔高地同海岸及北上汉志的道路相连。吉赞地处也门通往圣城的行旅通道上，海洋又将沿岸居民与近海岛屿连接起来。

english:
Tthets’ék’ehdéli lies where the Jean Marie River enters the Dehcho, or Mackenzie River, within the boreal country of the Great Slave Plain. The name recalls water flowing over clay. For its Dene people this was part of a much older homeland of rivers, lakes and hunting grounds, rather than a settlement whose history began with European arrival.

Community accounts describe earlier life through movement across the land: hunting moose and caribou, trapping beaver and fishing. These activities provide the local setting for the centuries before a permanent village developed. In the wider upper Mackenzie region, fur-trading establishments began to reshape exchange in the early nineteenth century; the North West Company established its post near the Mackenzie–Liard confluence in 1803. That regional development should be distinguished from Jean Marie River itself. Its permanent buildings belong to a later period, so a school, company store or fixed colonial town cannot be projected back into its pre-1837 landscape.
simp_chinese:
让玛丽河在这里汇入德乔河，即麦肯齐河，周围是大奴湖平原的北方林地。当地名称Tthets’ék’ehdéli意指流过黏土的水。对这里的德内人而言，这片河流、湖泊与猎场组成的家园有着更久远的历史，其起点并非欧洲人抵达。

社群记载通过在土地上的迁移描述早期生活：猎取驼鹿和驯鹿、捕捉海狸以及捕鱼。这些活动构成永久村落形成前数百年的地方背景。较广的麦肯齐河上游地区，在19世纪初开始受到毛皮贸易据点影响；西北公司于1803年在麦肯齐河与利亚德河交会处附近设立贸易站。这属于区域发展，应与让玛丽河本地相区分。当地永久建筑形成于更晚时期，学校、公司商店或固定殖民城镇都不应倒推到1837年以前的景观中。

english:
Jebba belonged to the river country of the Niger, where Nupe historical traditions met wider networks of movement and exchange. Its most distinctive surviving witnesses to the older regional past are cast-metal figures grouped with sculptures from Tada and Giragi under the name “Tsoede bronzes.” These works differ markedly in style, so their discovery in neighbouring river settlements does not establish a single workshop or common origin.

Nupe oral accounts associate the sculptures with Tsoede, the kingdom's culture hero. In one account he escaped from Idah during the sixteenth century, travelling upstream with sculptures and other valued objects. The story places the bronzes within memories of kingship and migration along the Niger. Their precise origins, however, remain disputed, and the oral narrative cannot securely date their manufacture or arrival at Jebba. The objects nevertheless make this river locality part of a specific historical landscape of prestigious metalwork, political traditions and connections extending beyond the settlements in which the figures were preserved.
simp_chinese:
杰巴属于尼日尔河地区，努佩历史传统在这里同更广泛的人口移动和交换网络相接。较早区域历史留下的独特实物，是与塔达、吉拉吉雕塑合称“措埃德青铜器”的铸造金属人像。这些作品风格差异显著，发现于邻近河岸聚落，并不能证明它们出自同一作坊或共同产地。

努佩口头叙事将雕塑同王国文化英雄措埃德联系起来。一种说法讲述他在十六世纪逃离伊达，携带雕塑及其他贵重物品逆流而行。这一故事使青铜器进入有关王权与沿河迁徙的记忆。然而，器物确切来源仍有争议，口传叙事不能为其铸造或抵达杰巴提供确定年代。这些实物仍使杰巴拥有具体的历史面貌：具有声望的金属艺术、政治传统，以及延伸至保存地以外的联系。

english:
Jecheon occupied an inland basin among Korea's central mountains, where routes linked Chungcheong with the neighbouring provinces. It received the name Jecheon in 1413 under the Joseon dynasty. Its local Confucian school had already been founded in 1389, and moved to Gyodong in 1590. There, instruction and ritual shared the same compound: the lecture hall served students, while the shrine honoured Confucius and other sages.

The mountain country also sheltered people at odds with the state. During the Catholic persecution of 1801, Hwang Sa-yeong hid in a dugout at Baeron, within the Jecheon district. He wrote a detailed letter on white silk describing the persecution and seeking help from the bishop in Beijing. The letter failed to reach its destination, and Hwang was arrested and executed. Between the recognised institutions of county government and Confucian learning, and the clandestine Catholic community at Baeron, Jecheon's religious history reflected the conflicting loyalties and dangers of late Joseon society.
simp_chinese:
堤川位于朝鲜半岛中部群山间的盆地，道路联系忠清与邻近各道。朝鲜王朝于1413年采用堤川之名。当地乡校早在1389年创办，1590年迁至校洞，教学与祭祀共处一院：明伦堂供学生读书，大成殿奉祀孔子及诸位儒家先贤。

山地也为同国家发生冲突的人提供藏身之处。1801年天主教遭到迫害时，黄嗣永躲入堤川地区舟论村的土窟，以白绢写成长信，记述迫害经过，并向北京主教求助。帛书未能送达，黄嗣永被捕后遭到处决。从官府认可的县治、乡校，到舟论隐秘的天主教社群，堤川的宗教历史呈现出朝鲜王朝后期相互冲突的信仰、政治忠诚及其带来的危险。

english:
Jeddah is the Red Sea harbour of Mecca, seventy kilometres to the east, and for centuries the landing place of pilgrims who came to the Hajj by sea. The Ayyubids of Egypt took it in 1177, and after the Mongols destroyed Baghdad in 1258 the Hejaz passed to the Mamluk sultans of Cairo, whose rule over the Holy Cities made the harbour a point of contact between Egypt, Arabia and the Indian Ocean.

When Vasco da Gama's arrival in India put the pilgrim and spice fleets at risk, the Mamluk sultan Qansuh al-Ghawri sent a fleet of fifty ships under Hussein the Kurd, governor of Jeddah, and the town was walled as a refuge for the Red Sea. In 1517 the Ottomans conquered Egypt, and the Portuguese admiral Lopo Soares de Albergaria's armada was repulsed at the siege of Jeddah that same year. The Ottomans rebuilt the walls in 1525 with six towers and six gates, among them the Mecca and Medina gates, and beat off a second Portuguese attack in 1541. From 1803 Najdi forces of the first Saudi state pressed the Hejaz and besieged Jeddah, which by about 1806 had come under Saudi suzerainty along with Mecca and Medina; Muhammad Ali Pasha landed at Jeddah in 1813 and restored the sultan's rule.
simp_chinese:
吉达是麦加的红海港口，位于麦加以西七十公里，几百年来都是乘船前来朝觐的香客登陆的地方。1177年埃及的阿尤布王朝夺取吉达；1258年蒙古人毁灭巴格达之后，汉志归开罗的马穆鲁克苏丹，他们对两圣地的统治使这座港口成为埃及、阿拉伯与印度洋之间的交会点。

瓦斯科·达·伽马抵达印度、使朝觐船队和香料船队受到威胁后，马穆鲁克苏丹坎苏·古里派出由吉达总督“库尔德人侯赛因”统率的五十艘战船，吉达也筑起城墙，成为红海的避难港。1517年奥斯曼人征服埃及，同年葡萄牙海军将领洛波·苏亚雷斯·德·阿尔贝加里亚的舰队在吉达之围中被击退。奥斯曼人于1525年重建城墙，设六座塔楼和六座城门，其中有麦加门和麦地那门，1541年又击退葡萄牙人的第二次进攻。1803年起，第一沙特国的内志军队进逼汉志并围困吉达；约1806年前后，吉达与麦加、麦地那一同归于沙特国的宗主权之下。1813年穆罕默德·阿里帕夏在吉达登陆，重新确立苏丹的统治。

english: Camas Creek winds south from the mountains north of the Snake River Plain and spreads into wetlands in the basin below. The marshes, ponds and grassy flats provide habitat for migratory waterfowl. This creek country lies within the ancestral lands of the Shoshone and Bannock peoples. Its seasonal waters gather against the northern edge of the broad volcanic plain of the Snake River.
simp_chinese: 卡马斯溪从蛇河平原以北的山地蜿蜒南流，在下方盆地中形成湿地。沼泽、池塘和草地为迁徙水鸟提供栖息之所。溪流地区位于肖肖尼与班诺克人的祖居土地之内；季节性水流汇集在蛇河宽阔火山平原的北缘。

english: Jeguakava lies in the Guaraní country east of the Uruguay River. In 1626 the Jesuit Roque González established São Nicolau, a mission settlement on the Piratini. Raids by bandeirantes forced its people to abandon the first settlement in 1637; São Nicolau was founded again nearby in 1687. Guaraní communities later resisted the transfer of the missions under a treaty between Spain and Portugal, and war followed in the 1750s.
simp_chinese: 杰瓜卡瓦位于乌拉圭河以东的瓜拉尼人地区。1626年，耶稣会士罗克·冈萨雷斯在皮拉蒂尼河畔建立圣尼古拉传教聚落。班代兰特人的袭击迫使居民于1637年离开原址；1687年，圣尼古拉在附近重建。后来西班牙与葡萄牙的条约要求转让传教区，瓜拉尼社群拒绝迁移，1750年代随之爆发战争。

english:
Jēkabpils lies on the Daugava, opposite Krustpils and its castle on the northern bank. The castle was founded by the bishop of Riga in 1237, near an older Latgalian trading centre. Across the river, a settlement grew around the Sala inn, attracting Russian Old Believers who had fled religious persecution.

Duke Jacob of Courland granted the settlement town rights in 1670, and it took the name Jēkabmiests in his honour. A small port served an iron foundry, while foundries and other local workshops supplied the duke's wider enterprises. In 1704 a Swedish army defeated a larger Russian force near the town during the Great Northern War. River trade later revived, bringing grain, honey and other goods downstream; a ferry to Krustpils opened in 1764.
simp_chinese:
叶卡布皮尔斯位于道加瓦河畔，与北岸的克鲁斯特皮尔斯及其城堡隔河相望。里加主教于1237年在一处更古老的拉特加尔人贸易中心附近建立城堡。河对岸，聚落围绕萨拉客栈兴起，吸引了逃避宗教迫害的俄国旧礼仪派信徒。

1670年，库尔兰公爵雅各布授予聚落城市权利，城镇因此以他的名字称作叶卡布米耶茨。小港口为附近炼铁厂服务，铸造厂及其他作坊则供应公爵的事业。1704年大北方战争期间，瑞典军队在城镇附近击败一支人数更多的俄军。此后河运贸易复苏，谷物、蜂蜜等货物顺流而下；1764年，通往克鲁斯特皮尔斯的渡船开通。

english: Jelai lies beside a river of southern Borneo that runs from the forested interior toward the Java Sea. The Mapam joins the Jelai in the lower basin, adding to the waters that flow toward the coast. Downstream, tides can carry salt water back into the river, while fresh water comes down from the upper reaches. Fishing and river travel belong to this landscape of channels, lowlands and coastal waters.
simp_chinese: 惹莱位于婆罗洲南部的一条河流旁，河水从森林内陆流向爪哇海。马帕姆河在下游流域汇入惹莱河，增加了流往海岸的水量。下游潮汐可将海水带回河中，上游则有淡水流下。捕鱼和舟行是这片河道、低地与沿海水域交织的地带生活的一部分。

english: Jeldesa lies in the dry country north of Harar, on a route leading towards the Gulf of Aden. The surrounding area belonged to the world of the Harar emirate and the caravan roads that connected the Ethiopian highlands with the port of Zeila. In this landscape, the availability of water and provisions shaped journeys between the coast and the interior.
simp_chinese: 杰尔德萨位于哈勒尔以北的干旱地区，处在通往亚丁湾的道路上。周围土地属于哈勒尔埃米尔国及其商队道路的世界，这些道路连接埃塞俄比亚高地与泽拉港。水源和补给影响着海岸与内陆之间的旅程。

english:
Jelgava stands on the low plain of the Lielupe, where the Livonian Order built a castle on an island in the thirteenth century.
